capabilities: create PARA folder structure in the vault root
create new entries from a basic template in a selected folder
move open files to matching archive folders
restore archived files to their original PARA folders
postpone and reschedule entries via a postponed folder
extras: The README links to Tiago Forte's blog post for a full explanation of the PARA method and invites feature requests via the issue tracker.
motivation: The README does not state why the author built it.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in support for the PARA method, so users must set up its folder hierarchy and move notes between Projects, Areas, Resources, and Archives manually.
summary: PARA-method helper that adds commands to initialize a PARA folder structure and create, archive, restore, and postpone notes.
